creator: Alexander Terp
description: Since one app holds every window (MIP-6 stage 3b), a window can be closed only from the GUI (⌘⇧W, the red button), so the contract tier cannot cover closing, the Reopen submenu or Reopen Closed Window. Add the verb through the one shared path, and a check: two windows, close one, list --closed shows it, reopen brings it back on its own tabs, one pid throughout. Raised 2026-10-03 when stage 4 landed.
title: 🪟 muster window close [NAME], so closing and reopening a window has a contract check
